newsitem.title: USA: Garden Botanika same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Garden Botanika same store sales rise.

text.p: Garden Botanika Inc said Wednesday that February sales increased 45 percent to $7.3 million from $5.0 million in February 1996.
Store sales, for the four weeks ended March 1, increased 60 percent on the strength of a 3 percent increase in comparable store sales. The number of stores increased to 257 from 153.
Catalog sales declined $0.2 million on reduced circulation from the February 1996 level.

The company said in a statement that in 1997 it will significantly decrease prospect mailings and focus efforts on its more productive house list. The company said the strategy will likely result in lower circulation and sales but is consistent with its two-year strategy to improve the catalog division's profitability.
